name: ay-skills
description: Small, human-approved workflows for AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Approval-aware workflows for AI coding agents
interface.longDescription: Approval-aware workflows from evidence-backed product and UI design through system architecture, APIs, database schemas, implementation, verification, writing, and Apple release.
defaultPrompt: Help me shape and complete this change.
Research this product idea and define a focused MVP.
Design the product screens, architecture, API, and database before implementation.
Implement this approved design and verify the observable result.
Diagnose this failure before repairing it.
Trace this streaming voice failure from provider bytes to audible output.
Write a clear technical article with useful visuals.
Prepare and verify this Apple App Store release.
